refresh_title: Reload this page and the session list
summary: {sessions} open sessions in {cards} windows. Tap a session to open it in the Claude app.
open_app_title: Open this session in the Claude app
close_title: End this session and close its tab on your PC
new_session_title: Open a new Claude Code session in this window on your PC
launch_title: Start this window on your PC and open a new session in it once it is up
no_cards: No windows or sessions are open on your PC.
closed_caption: The last {n} sessions that ended. Reopen brings one back with its whole conversation.
show_title: Show the sessions that were closed most recently
hide_title: Hide the list of closed sessions
reopen_title: Resume this session, with its conversation, on your PC
no_closed: No closed sessions to bring back
new_confirm_text: A new Claude Code session will open in "{card}"{group} on your PC.
close_confirm_text: "{title}" will end, and its tab on your PC will close.
toast_opening: Opening a new session on your PC. This can take up to half a minute.
toast_open_in_app: Open it in the Claude app ›
toast_new_nolink: The session opened on your PC. It is at the top of its window's list; its app link appears there in a moment.
toast_launching: That window is starting on your PC. The session opens there once it is up, usually within a minute. Refresh after that.
toast_closed_empty: Session closed. It had no message yet, so there is no conversation to bring back and it will not appear under Recently closed.
toast_reopening: Reopening the session on your PC. This can take up to half a minute.
toast_reopened_nolink: The session reopened on your PC. It shows up in the list in a moment.
pair_text: This device is not approved yet. TabTower on your PC is asking whether to let "{device}" in.
pair_code_label: To approve it, type this code into the prompt on your PC:
pair_wait: This page checks again every few seconds and opens by itself once you approve.
denied_text: The request from this device was declined on the PC. You can ask again in a few minutes.
err_unreachable: Cannot reach TabTower on your PC ({reason}). Check that Tailscale is connected on this phone and that TabTower is running.
err_wrong_user: This device belongs to a different Tailscale user than the PC, so it cannot be approved.
err_unknown_device: Tailscale on the PC could not identify this device.
err_funnel: This page cannot be opened from the public internet.
err_bad_host: This address is not allowed. Open the page through the PC's Tailscale name.
err_busy: Another action is still running. Try again in a moment.
err_not_found: It is no longer there. The list was refreshed.
err_no_window: That window is not available right now.
err_timeout: The new session did not report back in time. Check the list in a moment.
err_server_error: Something went wrong on the PC.
err_not_forwarded: This request did not come through tailscale serve, so it was refused. Open the page at the PC's https:// Tailscale address.
err_pairing_busy: The PC already has requests from other devices waiting for an answer. Try again in a few minutes.
